name: STEP Viewer 3D
description: View STEP CAD files (.step, .stp) in Orca: assemblies and parts as a list with color and visibility, wireframe, mesh quality, size and unit from the file. The OpenCascade converter runs in a background worker, fully offline, with no permissions. Export a copy as GLB, STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, PNG or a turntable video, compress a model under a size, and transform, decimate or check it as a copy.
